checks.sqltext: (start_at IS NULL OR isfinite(start_at)) AND (end_at IS NULL OR isfinite(end_at) AND start_at IS NOT NULL AND end_at > start_at)

checks.sqltext: execution_state = 'planned'::text AND start_at IS NULL AND end_at IS NULL AND actual_duration = 0::numeric AND status IS NULL AND context IS NULL OR (execution_state = ANY (ARRAY['running'::text, 'paused'::text])) AND start_at IS NOT NULL AND end_at IS NULL AND status IS NULL AND context IS NULL OR execution_state = 'finished'::text AND status IS NOT NULL AND (start_at IS NOT NULL AND end_at IS NOT NULL AND actual_duration > 0::numeric OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['postponed'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND start_at IS NULL AND end_at IS NULL AND actual_duration = 0::numeric)

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER study_interval_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public.study_session_intervals FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION cognova_prepare_study_interval()
CREATE TRIGGER study_interval_prepare BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.study_session_intervals FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION cognova_prepare_study_interval()

CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER study_session_intervals_execution_valid AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.study_session_intervals DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION cognova_validate_study_execution()
CREATE TRIGGER study_session_prepare BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.study_sessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION cognova_prepare_study_session()
CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER study_sessions_execution_valid AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.study_sessions DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION cognova_validate_study_execution()

constraints.definition: CHECK ((isfinite(started_at) AND ((ended_at IS NULL) OR (isfinite(ended_at) AND (ended_at > started_at)))))
EXCLUDE USING gist (int8range((session_id)::bigint, (session_id)::bigint, '[]'::text) WITH &&, tstzrange(started_at, ended_at, '[)'::text) WITH &&)
FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES study_sessions(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK ((((start_at IS NULL) OR isfinite(start_at)) AND ((end_at IS NULL) OR (isfinite(end_at) AND (start_at IS NOT NULL) AND (end_at > start_at)))))

CHECK ((((execution_state = 'planned'::text) AND (start_at IS NULL) AND (end_at IS NULL) AND (actual_duration = (0)::numeric) AND (status IS NULL) AND (context IS NULL)) OR ((execution_state = ANY (ARRAY['running'::text, 'paused'::text])) AND (start_at IS NOT NULL) AND (end_at IS NULL) AND (status IS NULL) AND (context IS NULL)) OR ((execution_state = 'finished'::text) AND (status IS NOT NULL) AND (((start_at IS NOT NULL) AND (end_at IS NOT NULL) AND (actual_duration > (0)::numeric)) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['postponed'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND (start_at IS NULL) AND (end_at IS NULL) AND (actual_duration = (0)::numeric))))))

CHECK ((((NOT (context IS DISTINCT FROM 'other'::text)) AND (other_text IS NOT NULL) AND ((char_length(other_text) >= 1) AND (char_length(other_text) <= 200)) AND (other_text = btrim(other_text)) AND (other_text !~ '^[[:space:]]*$'::text)) OR ((context IS DISTINCT FROM 'other'::text) AND (other_text IS NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (user_id, subject_id) REFERENCES subjects(user_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (user_id, subject_id, activity_id) REFERENCES activities(user_id, subject_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

all_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX ex_study_intervals_overlap ON public.study_session_intervals USING gist (int8range((session_id)::bigint, (session_id)::bigint, '[]'::text), tstzrange(started_at, ended_at, '[)'::text))
CREATE INDEX ix_study_intervals_session_started ON public.study_session_intervals USING btree (session_id, started_at, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX study_session_intervals_pkey ON public.study_session_intervals USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_study_intervals_open ON public.study_session_intervals USING btree (session_id) WHERE (ended_at IS NULL)
CREATE INDEX ix_study_sessions_owner_activity ON public.study_sessions USING btree (user_id, subject_id, activity_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_study_sessions_user_planned ON public.study_sessions USING btree (user_id, planned_start_at, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX study_sessions_pkey ON public.study_sessions USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_study_sessions_user_executing ON public.study_sessions USING btree (user_id) WHERE (execution_state = ANY (ARRAY['running'::text, 'paused'::text]))
